literal: Houzhu; Youzhu
idiomatic: Houzhu; Youzhu

literal: The Last Emperor, taboo name Wei, style name Rengang, was the eldest son of Emperor Wucheng.
idiomatic: The Last Emperor, whose personal name was Wei and style name Rengang, was the eldest son of Emperor Wucheng.

literal: His mother was Empress Hu. She dreamed that she was sitting in a jade basin on the sea, and the sun entered beneath her skirt; thereupon she conceived.
idiomatic: His mother was Empress Hu. She dreamed she was seated in a jade basin on the sea when the sun slipped beneath her skirt, and soon after she conceived.

literal: On the fifth day of the fifth month of the seventh year of Tianbao, the Emperor was born at the residence in Bing Province.
idiomatic: On the fifth day of the fifth month of the seventh year of the Tianbao era, the emperor was born at the princely residence in Bing Province.

literal: When young the Emperor had a fine appearance and bearing; Wucheng especially loved and favored him, and appointed him heir prince.
idiomatic: As a boy he was handsome in face and bearing, and Wucheng cherished him above all his children, appointing him heir prince.

literal: When Wucheng succeeded to the great enterprise, on the bingxu day of the first month of the second year of Daning, he was established as crown prince.
idiomatic: When Wucheng took the throne, on the bingxu day of the first month of the second year of the Daning era, the prince was formally established as crown prince.

literal: In the fourth year of Heqing, Wucheng abdicated the throne in favor of the Emperor.
idiomatic: In the fourth year of the Heqing era, Wucheng abdicated the throne in his favor.

literal: In the sixth month, on the renxu day, a comet appeared northeast of the Wenchang constellation; at first it was the size of a hand, then gradually lengthened until it reached more than ten feet; after a hundred days it vanished.
idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the renxu day, a comet appeared northeast of the Wenchang constellation. At first it was no larger than a hand, but it soon lengthened until it stretched more than ten feet, and only after a hundred days did it disappear.

literal: On the jisi day, the retired emperor issued an edict dispatching Concurrent Regular Attendant Wang Jigao as envoy to Chen.
idiomatic: On the jisi day, the retired emperor issued an edict dispatching Concurrent Regular Attendant Wang Jigao as envoy to Chen.

literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on the yiwei day, the retired emperor issued an edict adding one Commissioner of the Directorate of Waterways.
idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the yiwei day, the retired emperor issued an edict adding one Commissioner of the Directorate of Waterways.

literal: In the eleventh month of winter, on the guiwei day, the retired emperor returned from Jinyang.
idiomatic: In the eleventh month of winter, on the guiwei day, the retired emperor returned from Jinyang.

literal: On the jichou day, the retired emperor issued an edict changing "Grand Ancestor Emperor Xianwu" to "Emperor Shenwu," with the temple name Gaozu, and "Empress Xianming" to "Empress Wuming";
idiomatic: On the jichou day, the retired emperor issued an edict changing "Grand Ancestor Emperor Xianwu" to "Emperor Shenwu," with the temple name Gaozu, and "Empress Xianming" to "Empress Wuming";

literal: as for the posthumous title "Wenxuan," that was to be decided by the relevant offices through deliberation.
idiomatic: as for the posthumous title "Wenxuan," that was left to the relevant offices to determine through deliberation.

literal: In the twelfth month, on the gengxu day, the retired emperor hunted at the northern suburb.
idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the gengxu day, the retired emperor hunted at the northern suburb.

literal: On the renzi day, he hunted at the southern suburb.
idiomatic: On the renzi day, he hunted at the southern suburb.

literal: On the yimao day, he hunted at the western suburb.
idiomatic: On the yimao day, he hunted at the western suburb.

literal: On the renxu day, the retired emperor visited Jinyang.
idiomatic: On the renxu day, the retired emperor visited Jinyang.

literal: On the dingmao day, the Emperor returned from Jinyang.
idiomatic: On the dingmao day, the emperor returned from Jinyang.

literal: On the gengwu day, the relevant offices memorialized that "Grand Ancestor Emperor Wenxuan" should be changed to "Emperor Jinglie of the temple name Weizong."
idiomatic: On the gengwu day, the relevant offices memorialized that "Grand Ancestor Emperor Wenxuan" should be changed to "Emperor Jinglie of the temple name Weizong."

literal: That year, Goguryeo, the Khitan, and the Mojie all sent envoys to pay court tribute.
idiomatic: That year, Goguryeo, the Khitan, and the Mojie all sent envoys to pay court tribute.

literal: A great epidemic struck Henan.
idiomatic: A great epidemic struck Henan.

literal: In year 2, the bingxu year, spring, first month, on the xinmao day, he sacrificed at the Round Altar.
idiomatic: On the xinmao day of the first month of spring in the second year (bingxu), he sacrificed at the Altar of Heaven.

literal: On the guisi day, he performed the xia sacrifice at the Grand Ancestral Temple; an edict reduced the sentences of convicts by varying degrees.
idiomatic: On the guisi day, he performed the joint sacrifice at the Imperial Ancestral Temple; an edict reduced the sentences of convicts by varying degrees.

literal: On the bingchen day, Minister of Personnel Yu Jin was appointed Right Deputy Director of the Secretariat.
idiomatic: On the bingchen day, Minister of Personnel Yu Jin was made Right Vice Director of the Secretariat.

literal: On the gengzi day, the emperor proceeded to Jinyang.
idiomatic: On the gengzi day, the emperor proceeded to Jinyang.

literal: In the second month, on the gengxu day, the retired emperor returned from Jinyang.
idiomatic: In the second month, on the gengxu day, the retired emperor returned from Jinyang.

literal: On the renzi day, envoys from Chen came on a mission of friendly inquiry.
idiomatic: On the renzi day, envoys from Chen came on a diplomatic visit.

literal: In the third month, on the yisi day, the retired emperor issued an edict granting the Three Towers to Xingsheng Temple.
idiomatic: In the third month, on the yisi day, the retired emperor issued an edict granting the Three Towers to Xingsheng Temple.

literal: Because of drought, imprisoned convicts had their sentences reduced.
idiomatic: Because of drought, imprisoned convicts had their sentences reduced.

literal: In the fourth month of summer, Emperor Wen of Chen died.
idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, Emperor Wen of Chen died.

literal: In the fifth month, on the yiyou day, Concurrent Left Deputy Director of the Secretariat and Prince Pu of Wuxing was appointed Chief Minister of the Secretariat.
idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the yiyou day, Concurrent Left Vice Director of the Secretariat and Prince Pu of Wuxing was made Chief Minister of the Secretariat.

literal: On the jihai day, the retired emperor's sons were enfeoffed: Yan as Prince of Dongping, Renhong as Prince of Qi'an, Renjian as Prince of Beiping, Renying as Prince of Gaoping, and Renguang as Prince of Huainan.
idiomatic: On the jihai day, the retired emperor's sons were enfeoffed: Yan as Prince of Dongping, Renhong as Prince of Qi'an, Renjian as Prince of Beiping, Renying as Prince of Gaoping, and Renguang as Prince of Huainan.

literal: In the sixth month, the retired emperor issued an edict dispatching Concurrent Regular Attendant Wei Daoru on a friendly mission to Chen.
idiomatic: In the sixth month, the retired emperor issued an edict dispatching Concurrent Regular Attendant Wei Daoru on a friendly mission to Chen.

literal: In the eighth month of autumn, the retired emperor visited Jinyang.
idiomatic: In the eighth month of autumn, the retired emperor visited Jinyang.

literal: In the tenth month of winter, on the yimao day, Grand Preceptor Houmo Chenxiang was appointed Grand Tutor; Grand Marshal and Prince Jie of Rencheng was appointed Grand Preceptor; Grand Commandant Lou Rui was made Grand Marshal; Prince Run of Fenyang was transferred to Grand Commandant; and Han Zunian, Commissioner with Protocol Equal to the Three Excellencies, was made Minister over the Masses.
idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the yimao day, Grand Preceptor Houmo Chenxiang was made Grand Tutor; Grand Marshal and Prince Jie of Rencheng was appointed Grand Preceptor; Grand Commandant Lou Rui was made Grand Marshal; Prince Run of Fenyang was transferred to Grand Commandant; and Han Zunian, Commissioner with Protocol Equal to the Three Excellencies, was made Minister over the Masses.

literal: In the eleventh month, heavy rain and snow fell; the imperial vestments in the Ancestral Temple were stolen.
idiomatic: In the eleventh month, heavy rain and snow fell, and the imperial vestments in the Ancestral Temple were stolen.

literal: In the twelfth month, on the yichou day, envoys from Chen came on a mission of friendly inquiry.
idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the yichou day, envoys from Chen came on a diplomatic visit.

literal: That year, Prince Xiaowan of Hejian was executed.
idiomatic: That year, Prince Xiaowan of Hejian was executed.

literal: The Turks and the Mojie both sent envoys to pay court tribute.
idiomatic: The Turks and the Mojie both sent envoys to pay court tribute.

literal: In Zhou's reckoning, it was the first year of Tianhe.
idiomatic: In the Northern Zhou calendar, it was the first year of the Tianhe era.

literal: In year 3, spring, first month, on the renchen day, the retired emperor returned from Jinyang.
idiomatic: On the renchen day of the first month of spring in the third year, the retired emperor returned from Jinyang.

literal: On the yiwei day, heavy snow fell; on level ground it lay two feet deep.
idiomatic: On the yiwei day, heavy snow fell until level ground lay buried two feet deep.

literal: On the wuxu day, the retired emperor issued an edict that metropolitan officials in executive posts and honorary officials of rank three and above were each to recommend three men, and those of rank five and above were each to recommend two;
idiomatic: On the wuxu day, the retired emperor issued an edict that metropolitan officials in executive posts and honorary officials of rank three and above were each to recommend three men, and those of rank five and above were each to recommend two;

literal: officials titled as responsible for affairs of rank seven and above, as well as palace secretaries, inspector-generals of the Secretariat, clerks, and recorder-clerks of the Gate Office were each to recommend one person.
idiomatic: officials with the title of responsible functionary of rank seven and above, as well as palace secretaries, inspector-generals of the Secretariat, clerks, and recorder-clerks of the Gate Office were each to recommend one person.

literal: The Nine Dragons Hall of the Ye Palace caught fire, which spread to burn the western corridor.
idiomatic: The Nine Dragons Hall of the Ye Palace caught fire, and the blaze spread to burn the western corridor.

literal: In the second month, on the first day of the renyin month, the Emperor assumed adulthood; a general amnesty was proclaimed; craftsmen of the nine provinces were each promoted four ranks, and officials civil and military were universally promoted two ranks.
idiomatic: In the second month, on the first day of the renyin month, the emperor came of age. A general amnesty was proclaimed; craftsmen of the nine provinces were each promoted four ranks, and officials civil and military were universally promoted two ranks.

literal: In the fourth month of summer, on the guichou day, the retired emperor issued an edict dispatching Concurrent Regular Attendant Sima Youzhi as envoy to Chen.
idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the guichou day, the retired emperor issued an edict dispatching Concurrent Regular Attendant Sima Youzhi as envoy to Chen.

literal: In the fifth month, on the jiawu day, the retired emperor issued an edict appointing General-in-Chief of the Palace Guard and Prince Yan of Dongping as Chief Minister of the Secretariat.
idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the jiawu day, the retired emperor issued an edict appointing General-in-Chief of the Palace Guard and Prince Yan of Dongping as Chief Minister of the Secretariat.

literal: On the yiwei day, a great wind darkened the day, tore off roofs, and uprooted trees.
idiomatic: On the yiwei day, a great wind darkened the sky in broad daylight, tore roofs from houses, and uprooted trees.

literal: In the sixth month, on the jiwei day, the retired emperor issued an edict enfeoffing the imperial princes: Renji as Prince of Xihe, Renyue as Prince of Lelang, Renjian as Prince of Yingchuan, Renya as Prince of Anle, Rentong as Prince of Danyang, and Renqian as Prince of Donghai.
idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the jiwei day, the retired emperor issued an edict enfeoffing the imperial princes: Renji as Prince of Xihe, Renyue as Prince of Lelang, Renjian as Prince of Yingchuan, Renya as Prince of Anle, Rentong as Prince of Danyang, and Renqian as Prince of Donghai.

literal: In the intercalary sixth month, on the xinsi day, Left Chancellor Hulu Jin died.
idiomatic: In the intercalary sixth month, on the xinsi day, Left Chancellor Hulu Jin died.

literal: On the renwu day, the retired emperor issued an edict appointing Chief Minister of the Secretariat and Prince of Dongping Yan recorder of the affairs of the Secretariat; Zhao Yanshen, Left Deputy Director of the Secretariat, was made Chief Minister of the Secretariat; Lou Dingyuan, Left Deputy Director of the Jinyang Secretariat, was made Left Deputy Director of the Secretariat; and Xu Zhicai, Director of the Secretariat, was made Right Deputy Director.
idiomatic: On the renwu day, the retired emperor ordered Chief Minister of the Masters of Writing Prince Yan of Dongping to serve as recorder of the Masters of Writing; Zhao Yanshen, left deputy director of the Masters of Writing, was made chief minister; Lou Dingyuan, left deputy director of the Jinyang Masters of Writing, was made left deputy director; and Xu Zhicai, director of the Secretariat, was made right deputy director.

literal: In the eighth month of autumn, on the xinwei day, the retired emperor issued an edict appointing Grand Guardian Prince Jun of Rencheng as Grand Preceptor; Minister of War Prince Run of Fenyang as Grand Marshal; Grand Mentor Duan Shao as Left Chancellor; Grand Preceptor Hebaren as Right Chancellor; Grand Tutor Houmochen Xiang as Grand Mentor; Grand Marshal Lou Rui as Grand Tutor; Grand General Hulu Guang as Grand Guardian; Minister over the Masses Han Zunian as Grand General; Minister of Works Prince Rui of Zhao Commandery as Minister of War; and Chief Minister of the Secretariat Prince Yan of Dongping as Minister over the Masses.
idiomatic: In the eighth month of autumn, on the xinwei day, the retired emperor reshuffled the highest offices: Grand Guardian Prince Jun of Rencheng was appointed grand preceptor; Minister of War Prince Run of Fenyang, grand marshal; Grand Mentor Duan Shao, left chancellor; Grand Preceptor Hebaren, right chancellor; Grand Tutor Houmochen Xiang, grand mentor; Grand Marshal Lou Rui, grand tutor; Grand General Hulu Guang, grand guardian; Minister over the Masses Han Zunian, grand general; Minister of Works Prince Rui of Zhao Commandery, minister of war; and Chief Minister Prince Yan of Dongping, minister over the masses.

literal: On the jiyou day of the ninth month, the retired emperor issued an edict: "Among the miscellaneous dependent households under the jurisdiction of the various monasteries and offices who bear the surname Gao, although at the beginning of the Tianbao era there were preferential edicts, those who on a provisional basis still had not been released from corvée labor—now all such dependent households may be wholly exempted; they shall be assigned to their prefectures and counties and treated entirely as ordinary commoners."
idiomatic: On the jiyou day of the ninth month, the retired emperor proclaimed: "Among the miscellaneous dependent households registered to monasteries and government offices who bear the surname Gao, many were nominally favored at the opening of the Tianbao era yet still pressed into provisional labor service. Let all such households now be fully released from dependent status, placed under prefectural and county authority, and treated in every respect as ordinary subjects."

literal: On the dingsi day, the retired emperor proceeded to Jinyang.
idiomatic: On the dingsi day, the retired emperor went to Jinyang.

literal: That autumn, great floods struck the eastern provinces; the people starved, and corpses filled the roads.
idiomatic: That autumn catastrophic floods inundated the eastern provinces. Famine followed, and the dead lay heaped along every road.

literal: In the tenth month of winter, Tujue, Damolou, Shiwei, Baekje, Mojie, and other states each dispatched envoys bearing tribute.
idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, envoys bearing tribute arrived from Tujue, Damolou, Shiwei, Baekje, Mojie, and other states.

literal: On the bingwu day of the eleventh month, because the Daming Hall at Jinyang had been completed, a general amnesty was proclaimed; civil and military officials were promoted two ranks, and the next year's land tax and corvée levies were remitted for Juzhou city and Taiyuan Commandery in Bing Province.
idiomatic: On the bingwu day of the eleventh month, with the completion of Jinyang's Daming Hall, the court proclaimed a general amnesty, promoted all civil and military officials two ranks, and remitted the following year's land tax and corvée for Juzhou city and Taiyuan Commandery.

literal: On the guiwei day, the retired emperor arrived from Jinyang.
idiomatic: On the guiwei day, the retired emperor returned from Jinyang.

literal: On the jisi day of the twelfth month, the retired emperor issued an edict granting the late Left Chancellor Prince Chen of Zhao Commandery posthumous sacrifice in the temple court of Emperor Shenwu.
idiomatic: On the jisi day of the twelfth month, the retired emperor ordered the late Left Chancellor Prince Chen of Zhao Commandery to receive posthumous cult in the temple court of Emperor Shenwu.

literal: In the first month of the fourth year, an edict granted the late Prince Yue of Qinghe, Prince Pan of Hedong, Xiang Yue, and eight others posthumous sacrifice together in the temple court of Emperor Shenwu.
idiomatic: In the first month of the fourth year, an edict granted the late Prince Yue of Qinghe, Prince Pan of Hedong, Xiang Yue, and eight others joint posthumous cult in the temple court of Emperor Shenwu.

literal: On the guihai day, the retired emperor issued an edict appointing Acting Regular Attendant of the Scattered Cavalry Zheng Dahu envoy to Chen.
idiomatic: On the guihai day, the retired emperor appointed Zheng Dahu, acting regular attendant of the scattered cavalry, envoy to Chen.

literal: On the yisi day of the third month, the retired emperor issued an edict appointing Minister over the Masses Prince Yan of Dongping grand general; Prince Chuo of Nanyang minister over the masses; Xu Xianxiu, Bearer of the Grand Dignity of the State with the Three Honors, minister of works; and Prince Xiaogong of Guangning, Bearer of the Grand Dignity of the State with the Three Honors, chief minister of the Secretariat.
idiomatic: On the yisi day of the third month, the retired emperor appointed Prince Yan of Dongping, minister over the masses, grand general; Prince Chuo of Nanyang, minister over the masses; Xu Xianxiu, bearer of the grand dignity of the state with the three honors, minister of works; and Prince Xiaogong of Guangning, bearer of the same dignity, chief minister of the Masters of Writing.

literal: In the fourth month of summer, on the xinwei day, the Zhaoyang Hall of the Ye Palace caught fire, and the blaze spread to the Xuan'guang, Yaohua, and other halls.
idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the xinwei day, fire consumed the Zhaoyang Hall of the Ye palace and spread to the Xuan'guang, Yaohua, and other halls.

literal: On the xinsi day, the retired emperor proceeded to Jinyang.
idiomatic: On the xinsi day, the retired emperor went to Jinyang.

literal: On the guimao day of the fifth month, Right Deputy Director of the Secretariat Hu Changren was made Left Deputy Director, and Director of the Secretariat He Shikai was made Right Deputy Director.
idiomatic: On the guimao day of the fifth month, Hu Changren, right deputy director of the Masters of Writing, was made left deputy director, and He Shikai, director of the Secretariat, was made right deputy director.

literal: On the renxu day, the retired emperor arrived from Jinyang.
idiomatic: On the renxu day, the retired emperor returned from Jinyang.

literal: From the first month until this month there had been no rain.
idiomatic: From the first month until this month, not a drop of rain had fallen.

literal: On the jiazi day, the first of the sixth month, there was heavy rain.
idiomatic: On the jiazi day, the new moon of the sixth month, torrential rains fell.

literal: On the jiashen day, a great wind arose, uprooting trees and snapping trunks.
idiomatic: On the jiashen day, a violent wind uprooted trees and snapped trunks.

literal: That month, a comet appeared in the Well constellation.
idiomatic: That month a comet appeared in the Well constellation.

literal: In the ninth month of autumn, on the bingshen day, Zhou envoys came seeking peace; the retired emperor issued an edict appointing Palace Attendant Hulu Siwenlue to return the mission of friendly inquiry to Zhou.
idiomatic: In the ninth month of autumn, on the bingshen day, Northern Zhou envoys arrived seeking peace. The retired emperor dispatched Palace Attendant Hulu Siwenlue to Zhou on a return mission.

literal: On the xinsi day of the tenth month of winter, Chief Minister of the Secretariat Prince Xiaogong of Guangning was made recorder of the Secretariat; Left Deputy Director Hu Changren was made Chief Minister; Right Deputy Director He Shikai was made Left Deputy Director; and Director of the Secretariat Tang Yong was made Right Deputy Director.
idiomatic: On the xinsi day of the tenth month of winter, Prince Xiaogong of Guangning, chief minister of the Masters of Writing, was made recorder of the Masters of Writing; Hu Changren, left deputy director, was made chief minister; He Shikai, right deputy director, was made left deputy director; and Tang Yong, director of the Secretariat, was made right deputy director.

literal: On the renchen day of the eleventh month, the retired emperor issued an edict appointing Acting Regular Attendant of the Scattered Cavalry Li Xu envoy to Chen.
idiomatic: On the renchen day of the eleventh month, the retired emperor appointed Li Xu, acting regular attendant of the scattered cavalry, envoy to Chen.

literal: That month, Chen's Prince of Ancheng, Chen Xu, deposed his ruler Chen Bozong and enthroned himself.
idiomatic: That month Chen's Prince of Ancheng, Chen Xu, deposed his sovereign Chen Bozong and seized the throne for himself.

literal: On the xinwei day of the twelfth month, the retired emperor died.
idiomatic: On the xinwei day of the twelfth month, the retired emperor died.

literal: On the bingzi day, a general amnesty was proclaimed; artisans of the nine provinces were all promoted four ranks, and civil and military officials throughout the court were each promoted two ranks.
idiomatic: On the bingzi day, the court proclaimed a general amnesty, promoted artisans of the nine provinces four ranks each, and advanced every civil and military official two ranks.

literal: On the wuyin day, the retired empress was honored with the title Empress Dowager.
idiomatic: On the wuyin day, the retired empress was honored as empress dowager.

literal: On the jiashen day, an edict ordered that all fine-craft work and local artisan corvée be entirely suspended.
idiomatic: On the jiashen day, an edict halted all luxury manufacture and local artisan corvée throughout the realm.

literal: Another edict ordered that among the palace women of the Inner Quarters, Jinyang, and Zhongshan, and among the government household servants of the imperial kitchens at Ye and in Bing Province, those aged sixty or above and those suffering from chronic illness were to be screened and released by the responsible offices.
idiomatic: Another edict directed the responsible offices to review and release all palace women of the Inner Quarters, Jinyang, and Zhongshan, and all imperial kitchen servants at Ye and in Bing Province, who were sixty years of age or older or afflicted with chronic infirmity.

literal: On the gengyin day, an edict ordered that all families implicated and sentenced to exile since the seventh year of Tianbao be commanded to return wherever they were held.
idiomatic: On the gengyin day, an edict ordered the return of every family implicated and sent into exile since the seventh year of the Tianbao era.

literal: That year, Khitan and Mojie each dispatched envoys bearing tribute.
idiomatic: That year envoys bearing tribute arrived from Khitan and Mojie.

literal: In the first month of spring of the fifth year, on the xinhai day, an edict granted the three terraces of Jinfeng and others not yet converted into monasteries to the Daxingsheng Monastery.
idiomatic: In the first month of spring of the fifth year, on the xinhai day, an edict granted the three Jinfeng terraces and other sites not yet turned into monasteries to the Daxingsheng Monastery.

literal: That month, Prince Ji of Boling, Inspector of Ding Province, was executed.
idiomatic: That month Prince Ji of Boling, inspector of Ding Province, was put to death.

literal: On the yichou day of the second month, an edict universally exempted those liable to castration from punishment and enrolled them as government household servants.
idiomatic: On the yichou day of the second month, an edict commuted all sentences of castration, enrolling the condemned instead as government household servants.

literal: Another edict forbade netting hawks and falcons and the keeping or training of birds for sport in cages.
idiomatic: Another edict forbade the netting of hawks and falcons and the keeping or training of caged hunting birds.

literal: On the guiyou day, Damolou dispatched envoys bearing tribute.
idiomatic: On the guiyou day, envoys bearing tribute arrived from Damolou.

literal: On the jichou day, Prince Yan of Dongping was redesignated Prince of Langye.
idiomatic: On the jichou day, Prince Yan of Dongping was redesignated Prince of Langye.

literal: An edict appointed Palace Attendant Chile Changcha envoy to Zhou.
idiomatic: An edict appointed Palace Attendant Chile Changcha envoy to Zhou.

literal: That month, Prince Rui of Zhao Commandery, Minister of War, was executed.
idiomatic: That month Prince Rui of Zhao Commandery, minister of war, was put to death.

literal: On the dingyou day of the third month, Minister of Works Xu Xianxiu was made Minister of War, and Lou Dingyuan, Chief Minister of the Jinyang Secretariat, was made Minister of Works.
idiomatic: On the dingyou day of the third month, Xu Xianxiu, minister of works, was made minister of war, and Lou Dingyuan, chief minister of the Jinyang Masters of Writing, was made minister of works.

literal: That month, the emperor proceeded to Jinyang.
idiomatic: That month the emperor went to Jinyang.

literal: In the fourth month of summer, on the jiazi day, an edict converted the Jinyang Secretariat into the Daji Sheng Monastery and the Jin Shrine into the Dachong Huang Monastery.
idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the jiazi day, an edict converted the Jinyang Masters of Writing into the Daji Sheng Monastery and the Jin Shrine into the Dachong Huang Monastery.

literal: On the yichou day, the imperial carriage arrived from Jinyang.
idiomatic: On the yichou day, the emperor returned from Jinyang.

literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on the jichou day, an edict reduced the sentences of criminals, each according to his case.
idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the jichou day, an edict reduced criminal sentences, each according to the merits of the case.

literal: On the wushen day, an edict dispatched inspectors to tour the northern provinces of Hebei where rain had failed, granting preferential remission of land tax and corvée in districts suffering partial drought.
idiomatic: On the wushen day, an edict dispatched inspectors to tour the rainless districts of Hebei's northern provinces, granting preferential remission of land tax and corvée wherever drought had struck.

literal: On the renxu day of the tenth month of winter, an edict forbade the brewing of wine.
idiomatic: On the renxu day of the tenth month of winter, an edict forbade the brewing of wine.

literal: On the xinchou day of the eleventh month, an edict appointed Grand Guardian Hulu Guang Grand Tutor; Grand Marshal Prince Run of Fenyang Grand Guardian; and Grand General Prince Yan of Langye Grand Marshal.
idiomatic: On the xinchou day of the eleventh month, an edict appointed Grand Guardian Hulu Guang grand tutor, Grand Marshal Prince Run of Fenyang grand guardian, and Grand General Prince Yan of Langye grand marshal.

literal: On the gengwu day of the twelfth month, Prince Changgong of Lanling, Bearer of the Grand Dignity of the State with the Three Honors, was made Chief Minister of the Secretariat.
idiomatic: On the gengwu day of the twelfth month, Prince Changgong of Lanling, bearer of the grand dignity of the state with the three honors, was made chief minister of the Masters of Writing.

literal: On the gengchen day, Director of the Secretariat Wei Shou was made Right Deputy Director of the Secretariat.
idiomatic: On the gengchen day, Wei Shou, director of the Secretariat, was made right deputy director of the Masters of Writing.
